title: Research and Markets: Lockheed Martin Corporation: Defense Company Profile, SWOT & Financial Report - 2012 Edition
主要内容: This report provides an in-depth analysis of Lockheed Martin Corporation, a leading defense and information technology company based in the United States. The report includes a company overview, business description, competitive benchmarking, SWOT analysis, key facts, mergers & acquisitions, product and service information, key employee biographies, locations and subsidiaries, and key news events affecting the company. The scope of the report examines key information and issues about Lockheed Martin Corporation for business intelligence requirements, studies the company's strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats, and provides data on financial performance and competitive benchmarking. The report also covers business operations, company history, major products and services, prospects, key employees, locations, and subsidiaries. The report is intended to help users quickly enhance their understanding of Lockheed Martin Corporation, gain insight into the marketplace, and increase business/sales activities by understanding competitors' businesses better.
